D1

H4 Working

H1 Working

Enters from a higher up RBD One can clearly see two minor demand levels inside the H4 mayor D zone. The first minor D zone gets bounced and then engulfed as the PA hits the bottom of the mayor D zone. Once price clearly leaves the main D zone enter on M5 D zones and climb them up.

As there is a bit of a 1-2-3 and good compression up to 3, I would have entered short as soon as the price left the first retest of the M15 orange S zone (on a M5 chart) even the PA is still inside the H4 main blue S zone.

The PA drops through an H1 (khaki) SD zone with a DBD in a BEFL to a previously broken H1 SD zone now a fresh D. Enter on first retest of H1 zone in M15 or M5 chart. Partial profit taken at upper H1 broken SD zone and stopped out at BE on return to H1 demand.

The price retests H1 D and shoots up deep into a H4 S where when doing a first retest of a M15 S (the one from position 2 1-2-3) with a beautiful pattern and CP down to and braking the H1 D and from shoots down due to plenty of CP to the left.

Enter after 3 rd retest of fresh H4 D This trade I would have definitely lost if not watching the trade as BE would have not been triggered before 4th retest. There would have been a possibility to re enter at the flag, doubt I would have taken it.

3 times previously retested and now engulfed broken and violated. Way to messy for my taste would not trade it.

Almost a TT I might have entered from the minor D above it while it CP up

2 separate trades in position 8 Nothing interesting.

PA came down undecided after playing in the H4 and H1 previously tested S. After entering a previously tested D it ranged partly inside it collecting buy orders. Enter at A and B and add to position at C. Note mayor RS line just below D helping decision on multiple buy orders.

Don’t feel happy on entering at the H even minor RS there. Enter at the first or second retest of the M15 S. 10 is on the other end of the same daily candle as 9, second retest is on the next day bear candle.

A trade setup I love, beautiful approach from trade 10. Would have been stopped out after Partial at BE but definitely entered again long this thumb is in M15 to fit in more but M5 makes it a easy entry and enables multiple add-ons to pos.

No clear entry for me, don’t want to go short just above a mayor and minor RS. Stay out.

Big time CP up sharp drop. Follow up and enter above second H1 D one for a slowly developing but profitable trade.

H4 old untested History S A bit hesitant to enter but after second test of below S a nice trade.

12. Note the 2 light blue S@R lines below the PA at the time the price was at the most H it could have been a possible QM HH or an 2nd point of a 1-2-3 but as disregarded what is in the future for my decision ie. the sharp drop there was "no way for me to see the pattern" I would have stayed out of the based on the S&R levels below it.
